messages:
Elaine: Hey team — sales + security ask. We got a SIG questionnaire from Acme Corp for the POC; they want per-question evidence for the 'Security & Risk' section. I'm starting a question-by-question handoff sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1abcDEFghiJkLmNoPqRsT Please reply with evidence links or short snippets and tag owner. Need a first pass by EOD Wed.

TJ: Thanks. Could folks call out which controls map to SIG v1.1 Q12–Q20? I’ll compile. Who owns KMS/S3 policy?

Rob: I can take S3/KMS. Evidence: AWS KMS usage doc: https://internal.redwood/kms-kb ; SOC2 report: https://vault.redwood/reports/soc2-redwood-2025.pdf

Michael: Network segmentation + infra diagram uploaded -> https://images.redwood/arch/pvt-vpc.png

Kevin: For app-level auth, here's the OAuth2 config snippet we reference in answers:
```
issuer: https://auth.redwood.com
audience: redwood-api
```

Rob: S3 bucket policy (redacted example):
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456:role/redwood-svc"},"Action":"s3:GetObject","Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-storage/*"}]
}
```

TJ: For SIG Q14 (data encryption at rest), point to SOC2 + KMS doc above. Also mention default server-side encryption (SSE-KMS) for hosted models and the customer-key option for Private (KMS/HSM).

Elaine: Action items:
- Rob: upload S3 policy redacted to shared drive and drop link (due Tue 5pm) @Rob
- Michael: confirm VPC flow logs retention period and paste note (due Tue) @Michael
- Kevin: write 2-line statement on app auth and token rotation (due Tue) @Kevin

Rob: Uploaded S3 policy redacted -> https://drive.redwood/restricted/s3-policy-redacted.pdf :thumbsup:

Michael: VPC flow logs retained 90 days by default; can be extended for Private deployments. Added note to sheet.

TJ: Small ask: for SIG Q18, they want multi-factor auth evidence for admin console. We have Okta screenshots — I'll attach to the sheet.

Elaine: Great. I'll stitch all links into the SIG answers worksheet and then pass to Acme. If anything else, ping me here. Thanks! :pray:
